$comment: Questions with known answers, run against every surface. These are the contract: if a refactor changes an answer, the test says so instead of a stranger finding out. Every fixture is a question a real user would ask, and the expected value is what the corpus actually says — measured, not assumed.

lookups.why: a substance and the forms it takes share an id, so one name resolves to three entries
the planet, and the talisman made for it

searches.why: a name match must outrank the entries that merely mention it
no entry is called Goetia; the match is in body text, which is the point of full-text search

finds.why: the structured question: every herb the corpus assigns to Mars
three fields are ANDed by default; basil is fire, Mars and tier 1
a dotted path into a nested field, which is where the timing rules actually live
matching a value inside an array of vocabulary terms, not a reference

paths.why: basil —planet→ mars —planets(in)→ protection: the second edge is a backlink, so a forward-only walk cannot find this
an aromatic herb reaches a deity through the god it is assigned to
a thing is its own path; this must not hang or return not-found
tarot cards are graph islands — no reference connects them, and `path` must say so rather than implying the concepts are unrelated

when.$comment: A fixed instant, so phase dates and windows cannot drift with the clock. 2026-10-31 20:00 Sydney is a Saturday night; the last quarter is two days off, and the next sabbat inside a 60-day horizon from 1 November is Yule on the 21st.

entry_ambiguity.why: one id, four catalogues — `entry` must return every one in full, not just the first

fields.why: the field list is what makes `find` usable: 12 in herbs (the `description` each material gained on 2026-11-05 is the twelfth), with the multi-valued and numeric ones marked

must_resolve.why: a tarot suit — nested inside tarot_system.suits, not a top-level entry, and 160 references name it
one id, four catalogues: an archetype, a herb, a resin and an essential oil
the first hexagram, whose Wu Xing phase now resolves to wu_xing.json

not_joins.why: lunar energy vocabulary, not a compass bearing
a Latin letter, not a Hebrew letter id
Wu Xing ids under a cycle field; never elements.json

timing.$comment: A fixed instant in a fixed place, so the answer cannot drift with the clock. Sydney, 2026-10-31, is a Saturday: Saturn's day.
